title: Louis Armstrong's tone and a recent meeting
summary: Charles says Armstrong's tone was the same then as now and recalls seeing him after 35 years.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well tell me, when Louis was playing in those days in New Orleans, what kind of tone did he use? Is that smoother or a smoother tone? Louis? Yes. Louis Armstrong.
Louis Armstrong? Yes. Practically the same like he was using them. Is that right? Yeah. You remember when he played at SLI the last time? I was there.
You were. You didn't want me to leave. Oh, I can see. I met his friends and I think. 35 years since I've seen that boy. Oh, my.
